name: World Scribe
tagline: Keep track of characters, places, and lore for your stories
description:
World Scribe is a writing companion for anyone building a fictional world, whether for a novel, a tabletop game, or just for fun. Keep track of characters, places, histories, and all the details that make your world feel real.

It's a focused tool for writers and worldbuilders who need somewhere to organize their ideas without losing track of the details.
